info.title: CamusDB SQL Shell 0.9.2 (alpha
info.description: camus-cli is a command-line interface for interacting with CamusDB

commands.name: workload
commands.description:
workload run  <bank|northwind|factory|tpcc>  Run a continuous workload against
the database

options.name: --connection-source
options.description:
Connection string (default: gRPC on
http://localhost:5096,
falling back to REST on http://localhost:5095)

options.name: --database
options.description: Target database name (default: demo)

options.name: --rows
options.description:
Number of rows to generate for init (default: 1000,
bank only)

options.name: --concurrency
options.description:
Parallel workers for run, parallel writers for init
(default: 64)

options.name: --duration
options.description: Run duration in seconds (default: 60)

options.name: --locking
options.description:
Locking mode: optimistic | pessimistic (default:
optimistic)

options.name: --isolation
options.description:
Isolation level: serializable | read-committed
(default: serializable)

options.name: --no-prepare
options.description:
Run every statement inline instead of preparing it,
to compare
against the default prepared path

options.name: --user
options.description: User to authenticate as (authenticated servers only)

options.name: --password
options.description: That user's password

options.name: --password
options.description:
That user's password; prompted for when -u is
given without it

options.name: --token
options.description:
Use a bearer token obtained elsewhere instead of
logging in

options.name: --force-rich
options.description:
Force the rich line editor (colors, multiline,
Tab completion)
on terminals whose TERM value Spectre.Console
doesn't recognize

options.name: --diagnose-terminal
options.description:
Print terminal capabilities and exit (why rich
mode is on/off)

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help message

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show version information
Environment variables:
CAMUS_FORCE_RICH=1            Same as --force-rich (accepts 1/true/yes)
CAMUS_USER                    Default for -u
CAMUS_PASSWORD                Default for -p (keeps the password out of the
shell history)
CAMUS_ACCESS_TOKEN            Default for --token

-u, --user / -p, --password   Credentials for an authenticated server
Shell commands:
use <database>              Switch the current database
source <file>               Run the statements in a file
show prepared [sql]         What the driver keeps prepared; with SQL, whether
that
statement is prepared (alias: \prepared)
clear / exit / quit         Clear the screen / leave the shell
